notes.title: December Update
notes.content:
Greeting, I manage to make some update and adjustment to prevent some bug and issue as well as to enhance the player's experience. Here are some of the update I made.

- Prevent some minor glitch.
- Prevent some game breaking issue in the later level.
- Raise the fps cap to 120 fps.
- Turn off the motion blur(don't hesitate to write me if this specific problem is still there).
- Correct some bug with the platform.

Of course, I am always ready to fix my game so as usual if there are any issue, feel free to tell me and it will be fixed pretty quickly.

Thanks you and I wish you in advance an happy holiday and a happy new year

Sincerely,
maelstrom Rabbit
